overview: Interactive Restic backup agent. Configures repository URL, encryption password, paths to backup, and a cron schedule. Installs restic and registers a scheduled backup script.
prerequisites: Restic repository reachable from this server (local, SFTP, S3, etc.)
Paths to backup exist on disk

steps.title: Install the package
steps.command: sudo apt update && sudo apt install himosoft-backup-agent

steps.title: Configure backup
steps.body: Prompts for repository URL, password, backup paths, and cron schedule.

commands.description: Show config and last run info
